set.body:
Before ANY crosswalk code changes, capture what production produces now, so the verify step has something exact to compare against. The arithmetic is meant to be identical, so the comparison is byte-for-byte.

Run `sherlockRecallMap` (SherlockRecallMapping.scala:233) on the admitted Sherlock annotation table and at least one admitted recall export from the git-ignored data root (tools/data-root.sh). Commit ONLY content-free evidence: the command, the input artifact digests, the output digest, and the printed counts (annotation rows, scenes, world order). The output stays under the data root; it can carry stimulus prose and recall words (rule 14(d)).

Also record the MediaLocus table as a digest: for every annotation row, (row, part, startTick, endTick) -- numbers only, no descriptions. That is exactly what the locus child changes, so it is the most direct comparison.

Accept: a committed receipt with the digests, and the run is repeatable (run twice, identical digests).
set.title: C1: capture a content-free baseline of sherlockRecallMap output on the real data root BEFORE any crosswalk change
